boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Ohio State Athletics Ticket Office: (614)292-2624 or (800) GO-BUCKS
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Ohio Stadium Ticket Office is located at Gate 5 and is only open on the day of the game/event. Hours may vary depending on the event. Please contact our main ticket office during regular business hours for more information. Ohio State Athletics Main Ticket Office is located near the NE rotunda of the Schottenstein Center. Regular Business Hours: Mon-Fri: 9am-4pm, Sat-Sun: Closed
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: American Express, Discover, Mastercard, Visa and Cash
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: General public will call tickets my be picked up at the Athletics Ticket Office in the Schottenstein Center during regular business hours (Monday-Friday, 9am-4pm). On game day, will call is located at the Gate 5 ticket office and opens 3 hours prior to kick off. Proper photo ID is required for pick-up. *Please note that all parking passes being held in will call must be picked up prior to 4pm ET on the Friday before the game at the main ticket office located in the Schottenstein Center. Wil call for the following groups is located at the Gate 5 ticket office of Ohio Stadium and will be open 2 hours prior to kickoff and closes after halftime: -Ohio State student athlete guests -Non-football recruits

venues.parkingDetail: Please visit https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/gameday/parking/ for parking maps, shuttle services, construction updates and additional information. DAY OF GAME LOTS: Parking is available day of game on a first-come, first-served basis. The charge for these lots is $30 or $25 depending on lot. Those holding current valid Ohio State Parking Permit (A, B, C, etc.) may park in these lots free of charge. Shuttle service to Ohio Stadium is available free of charge for guests who park on west campus (parking lots west of SR 315). DISABILITY LOTS: Disability Parking is located in the lots north of St. John Arena and in the Lane Avenue Garage. These areas will both be available on a first come, first serve basis. A current state issued disability placard, along with registration, and the person who owns the placard must be in the vehicle to enter the parking area. (Officers may validate ownership of the placard at any time.) A shuttle will transport fans from the parking lots north of St. John Arena to Gate 22, which is located on the east side of Ohio Stadium. This shuttle will operate from six hours prior to kick-off until one hour after the game. SEASON PERMIT LOTS: These lots are reserved for those who have purchased a season parking permit. RV LOTS: All RV parking on The Ohio State University campus is sold in advance of game day through the Ohio State Buckeyes website at ohiostatebuckeyes.com. Please visit www.ohiostatebuckeyes.com for RV parking maps and information. The Season RV Parking Lot, which is located next to Bill Davis Stadium is reserved for season ticket holders only. Day of Game RV Parking Lot passes, which are located on Fred Taylor Drive across the street from Jesse Owens Memorial Stadium, must be purchased in advance of game day by going to ohiostatebuckeyes.com through the ticket office page. Day of Game RV Parking Lot passes can only be purchased on a game-by-game basis. All RV parking spaces are numbered and pre-assigned. RV parking passes WILL NOT be for sale on game days.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Special seating is available for guests with disabilities. Customers interested in exchanging tickets for accessible seating should do so ahead of time by submitting a request here: https://accessibility.osu.edu/athletic-department-disability-needs-form/#online-form. There will be Day of Game/Event exchanges, but will be offered on a first come, first serve basis. Details regarding accessible seating options can be found here: https://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/sports/2018/6/5/ada-information-ohio-stadium

generalInfo.generalRule: Gates open 2 hours prior to kickoff. For more information, please visit http://ohiostatebuckeyes.com/gameday.
generalInfo.childRule: Per Big Ten policy, everyone needs a ticket for entry to football games. Fans wishing to bring small children (under the age of 2) to a football game may purchase a lap ticket for $10 for their infant. This ticket will allow the infant to enter the venue, but that child must sit on their parent/guardians' lap. If a seat must be occupied but the child and/or the carrier, then a regular ticket must be purchased. Lap tickets are only available on the day of the game/event and can only be purchased at the Gate 5 ticket office.
